categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Adds functional test coverage specifically for node-initiated P2P connection logic, including stale tip connections, block-relay-only peer rotation, and network diversification.
categories.rationale: The PR adds end-to-end test coverage for core P2P connection management and peer selection behaviors that previously lacked automated testing. While valuable for catching regressions in eclipse and partition resistance mechanisms, adding test coverage for existing behavior is reasonably deferrable.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Modifies test framework machinery (`BitcoinTestFramework`) to introduce `auto_outbound_mode` via SOCKS5 proxy redirection and carries the Tests label.
categories.rationale: It generalizes proxy redirection machinery into the test framework to allow functional tests to observe autonomous node-initiated outbound connections. This introduces a helpful testing capability for high-risk P2P logic while de-duplicating custom test code.
